PSM: Learning Probabilistic Embeddings for Multi-scale Zero-Shot Soundscape Mapping
Subash Khanal
Washington University in St. Louis
Saint Louis, United States
k.subash@wustl.edu
KEYWORDS
Soundscape Mapping; Audio Visual Learning; Probabilistic Representation Learning
ABSTRACT
A soundscape is defined by the acoustic environment a person perceives at a location.
1 INTRODUCTION
Soundscape mapping involves understanding the relationship between locations on Earth and the distribution of sounds at those locations.
